contract: Pure load-time check of a recipe package, or of a recipe outside a package, against caller-supplied facts: structure by the ready validators located at its part, then every tool, declared need and permission and cost compared, with an exact upper cost against a cap; an ok verdict or all refusal reasons in a fixed order, no execution, grant or budget.
limits: Finite named scenarios only; no new Cure law selected, and reused Piece Contracts stay scoped to those Pieces.

Compares and sums; grants no permission, reserves no budget, is no tenant quota and calls no authorization, approval or budget function; the engine still checks authority, approval and budget at run time. Settings of a tenant are not checked.

A structural fault is located at its part (the package, graph, settings or skills) because the ready validators stop at the first fault and give no path. A tool that changes or leaves its source after the snapshot is not seen; agent and decision bindings are opaque.
No I/O, clock, process or storage.

grounding.claim: Named groups structural_faults_located, tools_exist, needs_and_permissions, upper_cost, all_reasons_in_order and same_input_same_verdict exercise the located structural faults, tool resolution, requirements, grants, exact upper costs, reason order, repeated and cross-process results, fixed redacted refusals, captured logs, bounds and the checked example; finite listed scenarios pass. Two temporary production mutations (count only the taken branch in the sum; skip the grant comparison) are negative controls that make the upper_cost and needs_and_permissions groups fail, never shipped.

A truthful snapshot captured for this recipe, truthful requirements of each tool, truthful grants of the tenant, estimates that are upper limits in one unit, and a caller that runs only a package whose check gave ok and keeps the verdict with the package identity. A snapshot not made by ToolRegistry.snapshot/1 or refresh/3 is outside the interface.

telemetry.contract: Pure check emits no logs or observations.

config.contract: Intrinsic operands and fixed bounds; no ambient settings.
